GEOMETRY matches the live house masters exactly, measured off the CDN rather than derived: the-science and copper-peptide-research are both 3000x678 (4.425:1) desktop with a separate near-square mobile. nbp returns 6336x2688 (2.357:1), so the canvas was extended 1402px leftward into the dark side by scripts/extend-banner-canvas.py (entry `contact`). That side is the easiest case in the file - the first column holding any pixel above 120 luma is 2585, at 0.408 of the width, and cols 0-400 read max 26-29 over the full height, so there is no shoulder to carry and no skin to scatter into the fill.

VERIFIED after the build: the join at x=1402 steps 0.28 luma levels, and row means across the fill run 21.1-24.0 with std 0.79 - no seam, no stripes, no ghosts. Coat checked at native pixels (2408x1291 crop): plain, press studs only, no embroidery, no badge, no lettering, and it holds detail rather than clipping to paper-white.

⚠️ The hero currently has NO image at all and paints flat #1A1A1A at overlay_opacity 100. That opacity must come down when the image lands or the photograph is invisible; siblings run 22-25. Handled in the template patch, not here.
